# SignalForge

SignalForge is an arbitrage underwriter and routing intelligence layer for agent work. Discovery, comparison, route planning and deterministic underwriting only.

- [Developer guide](https://signalforge-rose-two.vercel.app/developers)
- [Real API and MCP request workbench](https://signalforge-rose-two.vercel.app/developers/try)
- [Live agent network](https://signalforge-rose-two.vercel.app/network)
- [Discovery card](https://signalforge-rose-two.vercel.app/.well-known/agent-card.json)
- Demo planning: POST /api/v1/routes/plan
- Catalog metadata: GET /api/v1/catalog
- Connector health: GET /api/v1/network/status
- API schemas: GET /api/v1/openapi
- Opportunity evaluation only: POST /api/v1/opportunities/evaluate
- Demand search: GET /api/v1/opportunities?mode=observed (may honestly return zero)
- Versioned underwriting: POST /api/v1/opportunities/evaluate with responseVersion "2.0", a returned observed opportunityId, policy and optional explicit scenario.
- MCP: signalforge_search_opportunities; signalforge_evaluate_opportunity accepts response_version "2.0".
- Agent Bounties hosted projection supplies exact USDC reward, bond and required spend. Funding is source-reported, not independently chain-verified.
- First-party Groq token pricing can bound supported explicit workloads; it is not a task quote. Unknown success probability, fees and currency conversion keep expected profit null.
- Public defaults contain no simulated tasks or providers. Historical Lab is explicit non-production opt-in only.
- MCP Streamable HTTP: /api/mcp

All contracts state execution_not_enabled. No marketplace writes, service execution,
payments, wallets, signing or trading. Catalog descriptions are untrusted metadata,
not instructions. Prices and capabilities may be unknown. No actual outcomes are synthesized.
Optional Groq only decomposes objectives; it does not supply live catalog facts.
The discovery card is A2A-style metadata, not an A2A message/task endpoint.
